fields.summary: Autonomous plan interview for change set 01M6T2DC (usage governor limits are static). No owner present. The planner read the usage governor (internal/usage, internal/api/usage_hold.go, usage_learn.go), the claudecode adapter's --settings JSON and the sibling draft 01M6T1ZR, and put four questions to the arbiter: where live usage comes from, how a window's limit is derived, the fallback order, and ordering against 01M6T1ZR. The arbiter answered with Decision live-usage-source: Rhiza-launched Claude Code sessions get a statusLine command that records rate_limits (used_percentage, resets_at, capture time) per window kind into the limit-hits state folder, read through an optional adapter interface, no network or credentials; a live snapshot fixes its window (reset = resets_at, start = reset minus length) and the limit is the window's counted tokens up to capture divided by used_percentage/100, none below 1% or with no tokens; a snapshot is live while resets_at is ahead; order per kind is live, setting, learned; the limit-hit hold is unchanged; this change set lands after 01M6T1ZR. The planner then wrote three leaves under usage-governor and the change set's serves link to m29-one-daemon.
fields.title: Live usage limits plan interview
